verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible capability for a consumer authenticator or password-manager app, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The agent-oriented llms.txt, markdown mirrors and machine-readable pricing are documentation for external agents, an adjacent feature rather than a built-in assistant, and the same llms.txt states 'Public API: None'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
